debrief db-021
1) the actor a-s-s-e-m-b-l-e-d a p-e-r-s-o-n-a f-i-l-e for the r-o-m-a-n-c-e s-c-h-e-m-e and l-e-f-t a p-r-o-f-i-l-e-d s-k-e-t-c-h o-n d-i-s-k while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y r-e-v-e-w.
2) the actor c-r-a-f-t-e-d a m-e-s-s-a-g-e s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e to b-u-i-l-d t-r-u-s-t and l-e-f-t a t-e-x-t l-o-g in the s-t-a-t-u-s file while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the s-e-c-u-r-i-t-y f-l-a-g.
3) the actor r-e-c-r-u-i-t-e-d m-o-n-e-y m-u-l-e-s for t-h-e e-x-t-r-a-c-t-i-o-n and l-e-f-t a p-a-y-m-e-n-t t-r-a-c-k in the l-e-d-g-e-r while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e c-h-e-c-k.
4) the actor d-r-a-f-t-e-d i-n-s-t-r-u-c-t-i-o-n-s to k-e-e-p v-i-c-t-i-m-s s-i-l-e-n-t and l-e-f-t a s-u-p-p-r-e-s-s-i-o-n d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t in the c-a-s-e f-o-l-d-e-r while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the l-e-g-a-l r-e-v-i-e-w.
5) the actor r-e-c-o-r-d-e-d the e-x-h-i-b-i-t in the c-a-s-e f-i-l-e and l-e-f-t a r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e n-u-m-b-e-r in the i-n-d-e-x while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-i-n-a-l r-e-v-i-e-w.
